property.name: query
property.value: select APP_ID as "APP_ID" from TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS where APP_ID IN (select ALLOWED_APP_ID from TB_ASMI_USER_APP_ACCESS where USER_ID=:userId and APP_ACCESS = 'A')

property.name: query
property.value: select APP_ID as "APP_ID",APP_DESCRIPTION as "APP_DESCRIPTION" from TB_ASMI_APP_MASTER where APP_ID IN (select ALLOWED_APP_ID from TB_ASMI_USER_APP_ACCESS where USER_ID=:userId AND APP_ACCESS='A' AND APP_ID=:appId)

property.name: query
property.value: SELECT DISTINCT NOTIF_CODE as "NOTIF_CODE" FROM TB_ASNF_APP_OS_NOTIF_CODE WHERE APP_ID = :appId

property.name: query
property.value: SELECT t1.USER_ID, t1.USER_NAME,t1.CREATE_TS FROM TB_ASMI_USER t1 LEFT JOIN TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN t2 ON t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID AND t2.APP_ID = t1.APP_ID WHERE t2.USER_ID IS NULL AND t1.APP_ID = :appId AND t1.USER_ACTIVE = 'Y'

property.name: query
property.value: Select APP_USER_ID as "APP_USER_ID",DEVICE_ID as "DEVICE_ID",CREATE_TS as "CREATE_TS",INTERFACE_ID as "INTERFACE_ID",USER_ID as "USER_ID" From TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL Where USER_APP_ID = :appId AND CREATE_TS between :startDate AND :endDate AND INTERFACE_ID IN(:interfaceId1,:interfaceId2,:interfaceId3,:interfaceId4) AND STATUS = 'S'
